name: Purity Seals
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Angel of Death operative shoots, fights or retaliates and you roll two or more failed attack dice, discard one and keep another as a normal success.

name: Auspex
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Angel of Death operative selects a target for Shoot, enemies within 8 inches of it cannot be obscured until the end of that activation or counteraction.

name: Chapter Reliquaries
text: You may use Wrath of Vengeance for 0 CP when the operative it names has an Engage order.

name: Tilting Shields
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Angel of Death operative fights or retaliates and the enemy has rolled attack dice but not re-rolled, the enemy cannot keep any result below 6 as a crit this sequence, which blocks Lethal, Rending and Severe conversions.
